C0116.title: Legal Risk Analysis of Click Fraud and Attribution Fraud
C0116.summary: A legal-risk analysis article explains that attribution fraud occurs when fraudulent channels exploit weaknesses in third-party attribution strategies by fabricating impressions or clicks to steal credit for user conversions. Common practices include click fraud, where large volumes of fake clicks are sent to claim organic user conversions, wasting advertiser budgets and using last-click attribution to disguise natural traffic as paid channel traffic for commissions. This risk requires advertisers to audit attribution paths, click quality, and channel-settlement rules.
